title: 🐛 fix(config): read a UTF-8 BOM in pylock.toml and the user config file

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+A ``pylock.toml`` or a tox user configuration file (``TOX_USER_CONFIG_FILE``) saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as
+some Windows editors do, is now read instead of failing with a TOML decode error or being ignored with ``failed to read
+config file``.

@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ def __init__(self) -> None:
 
     def _parse_config_file(self) -> None:
         parser = ConfigParser(interpolation=None)
-        with self.config_file.open(encoding="utf-8") as file_handler:
+        with self.config_file.open(encoding="utf-8-sig") as file_handler:
             parser.read_file(file_handler)
         self.has_tox_section = parser.has_section(CORE.key)
         if self.has_tox_section:

@@ -155,6 +155,15 @@ def test_cli_ini_is_utf8(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: MonkeyPatch) -> None:
     assert conf.get("a", str) == ("“Grüße”", "file")
 
 
+def test_cli_ini_with_utf8_bom(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    to = tmp_path / "tox.ini"
+    to.write_bytes(b"\xef\xbb\xbf[tox]\na = b\n")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TOX_USER_CONFIG_FILE", str(to))
+    conf = IniConfig()
+    assert conf.has_config_file is True
+    assert conf.get("a", str) == ("b", "file")
+

+def test_pylock_install_lines_utf8_bom(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    pylock = tmp_path / "pylock.toml"
+    pylock.write_bytes(b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + PYLOCK_TOML.encode("utf-8"))
+
+    lines = Pylock(path=pylock).install_lines()
+
